title: Maximize Cyclic Partition Score
description:
You are given a circular array nums and an integer k.

Your task is to:

Split nums into at most k subarrays
Subarrays can wrap around (because the array is circular)

For each subarray:

Range = max value − min value

The score of a partition = sum of ranges of all subarrays

Return the maximum possible score.

Example 1
Input: nums = [1,2,3,3], k = 2
Output: 3

Example 2
Input: nums = [1,2,3,3], k = 1
Output: 2

Example 3
Input: nums = [1,2,3,3], k = 4
Output: 3
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
The third line contains an integer.
